name: std::strlen
intro: Returns the length of the given byte string, that is, the number of characters in a character array whose first element is pointed to by str up to and not including the first null character. The behavior is undefined if there is no null character in the character array pointed to by str.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
str

 -

 pointer to the null-terminated byte string to be examined

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The length of the null-terminated string str.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output:
without null character: 7
with null character: 14
